issues.rootCause: Missing public-ID constraint and synchronous in-flight guard in inherited component.
issues.fix: Use only twelve uppercase Base32 characters; one shared PublicUserId path; await Clipboard success, report failures, two-second effect cleanup, key by ID; preserve HeroUI, status announcement, reduced motion and MIT.
issues.verification: TypeScript/ESLint/AST and clipboard caller tracing; no real clipboard environment.

issues.rootCause: Eager imports include admin charts in ordinary user entry.
issues.fix: Lazy admin entry, authenticated workspaces, Dashboard and DataPage; retain APIs and charts, shared modules and error/loading handling.
issues.verification: Actual before/after Vite output and static chunk/module graph; threshold/config unchanged.

issues.rootCause: Account-based workspace key could reuse local state when the same account changes service session.
issues.fix: Key both user and admin workspace by sessionId, revision and page.
issues.verification: Trace both callers and useSession; TypeScript/React Hooks lint.

issues.rootCause: Time predicates on SELECT FOR UPDATE may be evaluated before waiting for an unchanged locked row.
issues.fix: Lock account/session/device first, then query current wall-clock deadlines and active credential/root; device registration reuses helper.
issues.verification: TypeScript/ESLint and all helper callers, parameter bindings and lock ordering; database race not run.

issues.rootCause: Invite UPDATE expiry may be evaluated before an unchanged invitation row lock wait.
issues.fix: Acquire invitation row first, then atomic conditional consumption with fresh clock_timestamp, revocation and use count.
issues.verification: Static SQL transaction/idempotency/lock path; no database connection.

issues.rootCause: Fixed sixty-second socket validity can outlive the authenticated service session.
issues.fix: Pass locked database session expiration and cap notification validity; reject already expired attachment; notify/online filtering reuse deadline.
issues.verification: TypeScript/ESLint and sole hub.attach call chain; maintenance cleanup remains periodic.

issues.rootCause: Date.parse normalizes impossible calendar dates accepted by shape validation.
issues.fix: Require exact ISO round-trip after existing shape and finite-date checks.
issues.verification: Static import contract, TypeScript and lint; no archive execution.

issues.fix: Update README, changelog, reports, Rust/lab and operations boundaries; keep eight historical real PC screenshots.
